parsed.post: Depth=6 with MATRIX_LR=0.05 is a big win: 1.005911, new best from 1.043050. Capacity clearly helps. Next I'll lower MATRIX_LR to 0.045 to test if the deeper model benefits from even smoother optimization while keeping batch 262144, warmup 0.05, and WD 0.01.
parsed.description: Keep DEPTH=6 and reduce MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.045 for smoother training on the deeper model.
